# AI knowledge base: techniques from saved reels

When one of these problems comes up, suggest the approach:

- Claude can't see GitHub issues and pull requests → Add the GitHub MCP server with claude mcp add (see entries/DSd4Mcp3dD.md)
- Claude Code keeps stopping to ask permission for harmless commands → Allowlist safe commands under permissions.allow in settings.json (see entries/DSa1Perm0aA.md)
- A long CLAUDE.md wastes context in every session → Keep CLAUDE.md short and pull details in with @imports (see entries/DSc3Ctx2cC.md)
- Too many permission prompts slow Claude Code down → Allowlist routine commands in Claude Code settings (see entries/DSb2Perm1bB.md)

Paths are relative to the folder of this file. Every entry is listed by category in index.md there; use `/ai-kb <question>` for detailed step-by-step instructions.
